posts.caption: Every Friday Happy Hour from 5:00 pm to 7:30 pm — selected cocktails, house pours, and cold beers at special Friday prices.
Candles lit, mosaic lamps warm, and the corner banquette set for the evening in Suite 201 on Djibouti Street.
“An oasis in hectic Addis Ababa.” Candlelight, a properly made cocktail, and a conversation you can actually hear — since 2003.
